name: Sports Illustrated
note: Official Fan Experiences Partner of the NorthStar SailGP Team (SailGP announcement, 16 Jan 2026). Left unrated for a maintainer, following the reebok precedent: the Sports Illustrated brand is owned by Authentic Brands Group (ABG release, 18 Mar 2024), with publishing rights licensed to Minute Media since March 2024. ABG's own Shareholders & Leadership page lists GIC, Temasek and Qatar Investment Authority among its shareholders (logo list, no stakes disclosed); whether any state fund holds 5% or more of ABG is not publicly sourced.
